title: Household-Size Schedule for the Basis-Month Eligibility Credit
content:
**Schedule.** Under the household-size schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the basis-month eligibility credit on a Pre-K tuition account has an amount added by the number of the household's children holding a School Nutrition Services Meal Account in status active.

| Children of the household holding a School Nutrition Services meal account in status active | Added to the credit |
|---|---|
| three or more | 7.50 |
| exactly two | 5.00 |
| one or none | nothing |

Every active meal account of the household counts, whatever its meal status tier; an inactive account does not.

## Examples (hypothetical households)

| Meal accounts of the household | Counted | Added |
|---|---|---|
| three children, all accounts active | 3 | 7.50 |
| two active accounts and one inactive account of a child who withdrew | 2 | 5.00 |
| one active account | 1 | nothing |
